title: Contain latency regression with per-customer hedging and adaptive microbatch scaling
creator: Ethan Park
description: Multiple enterprise customers reported sudden increases in TTFT (first-token latency) and degraded tokens/sec across Hosted and Dedicated deployments when certain request mixes hit mixed-precision Llama variants. Impact spikes started 2026-02-28 22:00 UTC and correlated with a scheduler change rolled 2026-02-28 that altered microbatch handshake timeouts and kernel selection thresholds. This ticket contains an emergency containment plan, implemented mitigations, measurements, and follow-ups to prevent recurrence and restore SLOs.
observed_symptoms:
- First-byte latency increase between 30–220ms for affected model variants.
- Tokens/sec drop of 18–47% on 95th percentile workloads.
- Effects pronounced for multi-tenant fleets with mixed short and long contexts.
- Telemetry shows sudden microbatch occupancy collapse and increased kernel-selection fallback events.
timeline:
2026-02-28 22:05: customer support alerted on Slack.
2026-02-28 22:10: SRE paged the runtime-oncall.
2026-02-28 22:25: Initial triage: correlated spike with scheduler kernel-threshold commit (PR #7042).
2026-02-28 22:45: Temporary routing change to avoid mixed-precision variant for top 5 impacted customers.
2026-03-01 02:00: Deploy canary microbatch-handshake rollback to subset of Dedicated clusters -> immediate improvement.
2026-03-01 09:00: Implemented per-customer hedging route + adaptive microbatch scaling (config off ramp) as interim mitigation.
2026-03-04 18:00: Measured recovery: median TTFT back within SLO and tokens/sec recovered ~85% of baseline for hedged flows.
2026-03-05: Ongoing work to harden scheduler selection heuristics and add regression tests.
investigation_findings:
- Root cause: a kernel-selection threshold optimization reduced preference for int8-friendly kernels when microbatch occupancy dipped; combined with the handshake timeout tweak, some microbatches were scheduled with suboptimal kernels leading to higher per-token CPU/GPU time.
- Models affected: mixed-precision Llama-2-variants and some quantized community models.
- Reproducible on internal perf harness with mixed short/long prompt interleaving at moderate concurrency.
- Telemetry gaps: lack of per-customer microbatch-occupancy aggregation made it slower to detect customer-specific severity.
containment_actions:
- Immediate: Add per-customer routing override to route top-affected tenants to stable int8-compatible model variant.
- Immediate: Revert handshake timeout commit on scheduler for critical clusters (hosted + dedicated).
- Interim: Enable adaptive microbatch scaling: reduce max microbatch size for affected tenants and increase background warmup probability.
- Rollback policy: if TTFT improves <15% within 30m, revert on per-cluster basis.
mitigation_implementation:
- Config change deployed 2026-03-01 02:10 (rollback of handshake timeouts) across 6 critical clusters.
- Per-tenant hedging implemented via routing policy (route.priority_override) and feature flag `tenant_hedge_v2`.
- Adaptive microbatch scaler: new controller throttles microbatch formation when occupancy collapse detected; controller shipped behind `adaptive_microbatch` feature flag.
metrics_after_mitigation:
- Customer A: 95th percentile TTFT reduced from +210ms above baseline to +12ms within 45 minutes.
- Customer B: tokens/sec improved from 58% of baseline to 91% within 1 hour.
- Platform-wide: reduction in kernel-fallback-count by 84% on affected clusters.
production_notes:
- No data plane data was exposed; this is strictly a performance regression.
- For Private/VPC customers, ops team executed guidance to pull the rollback bundle and applied routing override in customer-managed control plane (documented).
- We left the hedging routes active for high-impact tenants while hardening is in progress.
runbook_updates:
- Added section 'scheduler-regression: hedging and microbatch rollback' to runbook (link below).
- New checklists for future kernel-selector changes: canary on mixed short/long context workload, per-tenant occupancy alert, and synthetic TTFT probes per region.
next_steps:
- Finalize kernel-selection heuristics (add amortized kernel-cost model) and land patch in runtime-1.20.
- Add unit + integration perf test for mixed short/long workloads to CI.
- Add per-tenant microbatch-occupancy aggregation to telemetry pipeline (observability epic).
- Plan controlled rollout for Private customers with upgrade playbook.
- Postmortem and customer communication draft by 2026-03-07.
communication_plan:
- Immediate: Notify impacted customers with summary and mitigation applied (support did on 2026-03-01).
- Follow-up: Detailed postmortem + RCA + mitigation timeline by 2026-03-07.
- Include recommended customer-side configs for Private deployments.
notes: This ticket should remain open until runtime-1.20 shipping includes the kernel-selection safety net and per-tenant telemetry is available. Consider expanding hedging automation to non-enterprise tenants if cost is acceptable.
